title: Page 49
transc:
SH Beckwith Culpeper  Washn Apl 21st 1864 
Libby For Crowd Tulip Shark Can by
reports that he will for ward by
South or Zodiac the James Bengal Simms
Pagan the Andrew Whistled States Star Benton
Davis Nelson Franklin The Edwards Sugar Austin
Douglas Oliver Allen and the Elliot Star
Brooks Snyder Russel Austin making in all
Nelson Fisher Smith and Mason yawl Costume


Geo D Sheldon  Wash'n Apr 21st 1864 9.30 PM
Rosetta For Knox Unity If you can block
the channel Baden Sidney so she can not
get in to Pamlico Sound we will have
some camels made in a few days to
lighten the Tecumseh Iron claid so she can
cross the bar at Hatter = as Platina feet
and protect all Waxy of Baden Smyrna yoke
Asst Brenton Fox How are you brave youths


Geo. D. Sheldon  Wash'n D. C. Apr. 22nd 1864 1045 AM 
Elizabeth Harsh Peach For Knave unity Despatch of last night 
received I learn that there are Pension Waldo Spit here
for Animal instead of Pebble whips You have all the
whig and should send it up for them zebra Send
also for a Purple Panama Spartans now at the Pacific
queenly here & ready to go to you yoke Bender
